title: Statuses
hook: **Statuses** are timed conditions — butter, freeze, chill, poison, hypno, wither, contagions, and more — that actually resolve in combat.

blindSpots.meaning: A timed condition on a unit. Not a permanent class, not a stock, not an element on the ring.
Statuses go on and come off through play. You do not buy them from a shop tab.
The catalog is real; not every status is common in every mode yet. Missing one in a mode is reachability, not a fake row.
Statuses that spread or mark (blight, rot, spark, and kin) — still statuses, not a second combat system.
Unsettled → Shaken → Afflicted is Vision for delve pressure — not something every lawn already runs.

alsoTrue: You read icons on the [lawn unit HUD](lawn-mirror-hud) under pressure.
How hard a status sticks ties to [resistance](shields-crit-resist).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Conditions with a clock. They change what a unit can do or how the next hits feel.
Familiar lawn wraps sit beside overlay pressure and contagion — one status language.

sections.title: Families you will see

sections.note: Exact durations and stacks are balance surface. Trust icons and tooltips in the build you have.

groups.title: On the lawn today
steps: Read status chips on the unit HUD above units.
Apply and cleanse through ordinary play — plants, zombies, skills when they land.
groups.note: Battle-stage UI for the same icons is still catching up with [interactive battles](interactive-battles).

doSteps: Run a lawn match with Lawn open in the control room.
Point at one status icon and name it (butter, freeze, chill, poison — whatever appears).
Watch whether it sticks, fades, or fails — that is apply, cleanse, and resist in one glance.
doNote: Element matchups: [six elements and omni](element-ring). Named combo recipes on top stay Vision — [named reactions](named-reactions).

mixUps.q: Is a status the same as an element?
mixUps.a: No. Elements are types on the ring. Statuses are timed conditions.

mixUps.q: Why don’t I see every name from the list?
mixUps.a: The catalog is real; reachability grows with content. Absence in a mode is not a broken row.

mixUps.q: Do statuses only exist on the lawn?
mixUps.a: No. They are combat language everywhere — lawn reach is just the first place you read them.

mixUps.q: Is Unsettled / Shaken / Afflicted live everywhere?
mixUps.a: That ladder is Vision for delve nerve. Do not expect it as daily lawn soup yet.

mixUps.q: Can I buy statuses with souls?
mixUps.a: No. They apply through play, skills, and content — not a stock spend.
